title: status --stats counts a verify waiting for approval as a failed verify
desc:
wb status --stats reports impl verify 38 runs, 13 failed, and concludes the step is fragile. In the log, 10 of the 13 failures ran in under 300 ms: impl verify stopped before running anything because the commands were not yet approved on this machine. That is a gate doing its job, not a failed verification, and counting it as one makes the history accuse the wrong stage.

ACCEPTANCE:
- impl verify notes when it stops for approval; the event records it as held, exit code unchanged
- --stats reports held runs apart from failed ones and never calls a step fragile on held runs alone
- --json history gains the held count per command; schema bumped only if a key changes
- older log lines read as before
- regression test built from the pattern in this repo's log
